description:
Our project of the week is GentleOS, a remarkable hobby operating system designed specifically for older computers. Developed by Luke8086, this open source project features two versions: GentleOS 16, which requires just an 8086 CPU and 192KB of RAM, and GentleOS 32 for slightly newer hardware. Watch to see how this lightweight system breathes new life into vintage machines like the classic Tandy 1100FD.

Resources: https://github.com/luke8086/gentleos
